entity.summary: Decentralized trading platform combining automated market making and order-book functionality on CoinEx Smart Chain. Its operations ended on 29 September 2026 as the underlying CSC network stopped operating.
entity.notes: OneSwap's 15 September 2026 first-party notice specified a complete service stop at 02:00 UTC on 29 September. The current OneSwap homepage independently confirms that CoinEx Smart Chain officially ceased operations at 10:00 UTC+8 on 29 September and that related developer services were discontinued. Taken together, these first-party statements support a completed shutdown of the CSC-dependent OneSwap service. The historical homepage may still display static trading/interface copy; do not treat its reachability as live protocol trading. Death reason records the underlying chain cessation, not a security exploit. Verified 2026-10-30.

events.title: OneSwap announced discontinuation of all services
events.description: OneSwap announced that all services would discontinue at 02:00 UTC on September 29, 2026 in connection with the shutdown of CoinEx Smart Chain and the CoinEx exchange platform.
events.notes: This is an announced future terminal shutdown. HEI does not emit shutdown_effective or set death_date until the scheduled cessation is confirmed.

events.title: OneSwap ceased services after CoinEx Smart Chain shutdown
events.description: OneSwap's official cessation notice set 02:00 UTC on 29 September 2026 for discontinuation of all services. Its live homepage later confirmed that CoinEx Smart Chain had officially ceased operations and related developer services were discontinued on that date.
events.notes: Post-deadline official homepage corroborates the underlying chain cessation; do not equate residual static frontend reachability with a functioning DEX.

evidence.title: Announcement on the Discontinuation of OneSwap Services
evidence.notes: First-party OneSwap notice stating that all services will discontinue at 02:00 UTC on September 29, 2026 and instructing liquidity providers to withdraw assets before shutdown.

evidence.title: Important Notice on CoinEx’s Orderly Cessation of Operations
evidence.notes: CoinEx's first-party final announcement independently states that OneSwap and CoinEx Smart Chain will cease operations on September 29, 2026.

evidence.title: CoinEx Will List ONES and Start Mining: Lock CET to Share 20,000,000 ONES
evidence.notes: CoinEx describes OneSwap as an on-chain one-stop trading platform built on CoinEx Smart Chain with permissionless token listing, automated market making, and order-book functionality.

evidence.title: OneSwap exchange profile
evidence.notes: CoinMarketCap's exchange profile states that OneSwap launched on September 18, 2020 and describes its AMM and order-book model.

evidence.title: OneSwap homepage notice: CoinEx Smart Chain officially ceased operations
evidence.notes: Current first-party homepage states that CSC officially ceased at 10:00 on 29 September 2026 (UTC+8) and all related developer services were discontinued; read together with the 15 September official all-service shutdown notice.
